name: 連絡先一覧の検索・表示・更新操作帯
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Salesforce list toolbar crop as a faithful Japanese localization. The exact reference is 661 by 51 pixels, an extremely wide shallow 12.96:1 strip. Preserve the full compact toolbar ratio; no blank bands, surrounding page, table rows, browser chrome, or extra controls.

At the left, reproduce one wide white rounded search field with a thin gray outline, a small gray magnifying-glass icon, and the placeholder 「このリストを検索…」. Match the source field's width and height. To its right, place the same compact icon controls in the same order and spacing: circular gear with a tiny blue caret; circular grid/table icon with blue caret; circular refresh arrow; circular sort up/down arrows; circular pencil/edit icon; blue filled circular chart control with white pie-chart glyph; and the partly clipped pale-blue filter control at the far-right edge. Preserve thin gray outlines, blue accents, round 36–38 px controls, and their source alignment on the 51 px-high strip.

Keep the search field and button row centered vertically with only the source's small white padding above and below. Use simple crisp monochrome icons except the active blue chart and light-blue filter. No labels besides the Japanese search placeholder, no added card frame, no larger buttons, no extra whitespace, and no other page context. Use the supplied crop as the authority for exact visible icons, spacing, color, and right-edge clipping.
reviewNotes: v001 preserves the search field, icon sequence, blue chart/filter states, and right-edge clipping, but ImageGen returned a 2170x725 (3:1) canvas with large blank bands instead of the source 661x51 (12.96:1) strip. Recent 10.48:1 and 4.84:1 items hit the same 3:1 limit, and their second reframing passes did not correct it; recorded needs-correction after one evidence-based attempt.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
